newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico petroleum reserves more conservative - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Mexico petroleum reserves more conservative - gov't.

text.p: Mexico Energy Minister Jesus Reyes Heroles said the nation's proven hydrocarbon reserves have not fallen, but new methodology for judging them is more "conservative."

Addressing recent confusion over Mexico's petroleum reserves, Reyes told foreign correspondents late Wednesday that state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) was bowing to international pressure and presenting externally audited, more conventional proven reserve levels.
